name: RobotEra L7
summary: L7 is RobotEra's 171 cm full-size bipedal humanoid with 55 DoF and 12-DoF dexterous hands, run by the company's ERA-42 vision-language-action model. It is pitched for industrial sorting and handling as well as dynamic demos such as spin jumps.
sensors: Binocular vision and 3D LiDAR with 360-degree field of view.
highlights: Runs RobotEra's ERA-42 end-to-end embodied AI model.
RobotEra reported over 200 robot units delivered across its products by June 2025 (KrASIA).
caveats: No official public price; reseller estimates vary.
Weight and runtime are not published in the sources checked.

sources.title: More than a hardware play: Robot Era's founder sets the record straight
